ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the heavens are split asunder in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Infitar is often linked to the cosmic upheaval accompanying the appearance of the Mahdi (aj), symbolizing the dissolution of the old worldly order to make way for divine justice. The 'splitting' of the heavens represents not merely a physical event but a metaphysical unveiling of truth, where the barriers between the seen and unseen are removed for all creation.
